name: DramaBench
description: DramaBench is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating drama script continuation across six dimensions: Format Standards, Narrative Efficiency, Character Consistency, Emotional Depth, Logic Consistency, and Conflict Handling. It combines rule-based analysis, LLM labeling, and statistical metrics for objective evaluation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly notable as an emerging evaluation for drama-script generation.
notes: Evaluates multiple independent quality aspects of drama script continuation with human validation.
